info.name: Devices API
info.description:
Requests and assertions for the local Devices API.

Select the Devices API Local environment (baseUrl http://localhost:8080) and run the collection from top to bottom. Later requests use the ids saved by the create requests.

Stream state changes is skipped by the collection runner and by Newman. The stream stays open, so send that request on its own, then change a device state from another request.

item.description: The stream stays open. The collection runner skips the request in this folder.

request.description:
Server-Sent Events. Send this request on its own and leave it open, then change a device state from another request.

A real state change arrives as one event:

event: device_state_changed
data: {"device_id":"...","previous_state":"available","new_state":"in-use"}

A name-only update, a delete, and a write that keeps the same state produce no event. Events are not stored, so this stream only shows changes that happen while it is connected.

The collection runner and Newman skip this request. skipRequest has no effect when you press Send on this request alone.

exec: // Automated runs must not wait on an open stream.
// Pressing Send on this request alone still opens it.
